topic: Cracking the Code: Information Theory and Entropy in Wordle

sections.title: The Core Concept: What is Information?
lecture_lines: Claude Shannon defined information as reduced uncertainty.
Unexpected events carry more information than expected ones.
Consider a coin flip: high uncertainty means high information.
animations: Fade in title "The Core Concept: What is Information?". Color: #FFFFFF.
Display bit '0' and bit '1' represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg]. Color: #FFD700.
Transform bits into a flowing data stream. Color: #00BFFF.

sections.title: Quantifying Uncertainty: The Entropy Formula
lecture_lines: Entropy measures our average uncertainty about an outcome.
We represent this using a probability tree structure.
The formula calculates bits needed to identify words.
animations: Fade in "Entropy Formula: H(X) = -Σ p(x) log p(x)" alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Highlight 'p(x)' representing probability of an event. Color: #32CD32.
Animate log function curve as it descends. Color: #FFD700.

sections.title: Applying Entropy to Wordle
lecture_lines: Wordle strategies aim to maximize information gain per guess.
Each guess acts as a filter on candidate words.
Optimal guesses minimize remaining entropy in the list.
animations: Animate entropy bars decreasing as info is gained. Color: #FFD700.

sections.title: Interactive Demonstration: The Strategy in Motion
lecture_lines: Watch our candidate pool shrink with every word guess.
Entropy bars visualize our path to the solution.
One great guess collapses 2,300 options into 60.
animations: Start simulation with initial guess "SLATE" using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/keyboard.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Visually shrink the candidate word pool on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/screen.svg]. Color: #00BFFF.
Highlight the final solution "ARISE" on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/screen.svg]. Color: #32CD32.

sections.title: Conclusion: Beyond Games
lecture_lines: Entropy is the secret behind efficient data compression.
It powers machine learning models and decision trees.
Your smartphone keyboard predicts words using these principles.
